exposure: Day of blastocyst vitrification (D5 vs D6)
cohort: Participants undergoing 7,606 cycles of single frozen blastocyst transfer.
finding: There were no differences in pregnancy and perinatal outcomes between D5 and D6 high-quality expanded blastocysts, but D5 expanded blastocysts showed better clinical pregnancy and live birth rates for low-quality blastocysts (with inner cell mass rating B or above).
